'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
**[[Israeli invasion of Lebanon (2024–present)|Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***An [[Israel Defense Force|Israeli]] [[drone warfare|drone strike]] in [[Tyre, Lebanon|Tyre]], [[Lebanon]], kills Haidar Hashem, the head of naval forces in [[Hezbollah]]'s [[Radwan Force]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/hezbollah-operative-said-killed-in-alleged-israeli-strike-in-southern-lebanon/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***A [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[drone warfare|drone]] strikes an [[pipeline|oil pipeline]] in [[Rostov Oblast]], [[Russia]], setting the pipeline ablaze for several hours before being put out by [[firefighter]]s. Russia also reports its air defence units repelled another drone attack near [[Novoshakhtinsk]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-stamps-out-fires-southern-oil-pipeline-2025-03-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024–present Serbian anti-corruption protests]]
**[[Serbian National Assembly brawl]]
***At least three [[Serbia]]n lawmakers are injured after [[flare]]s and [[smoke bomb]]s were thrown into the [[National Assembly (Serbia)|National Assembly]]. [[Ana Brnabić]], the [[President of the National Assembly of Serbia|President of the National Assembly]], described the attack as [[terrorism]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/at-least-three-serbian-lawmakers-injured-as-smoke-bombs-and-flares-thrown-in-parliament/ (CTV News)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Militants belonging to a splinter group of the [[Pakistani Taliban]] storm a [[Pakistan Army]] compound in [[Bannu]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], after two [[suicide attack|suicide bomber]]s blow themselves up at the entrance, killing 12 civilians and wounding 30 others after nearby buildings collapsed. Six gunmen are also killed in the [[shootout]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/4/double-suicide-bombing-kills-at-least-9-in-north-west-pakistan-police (Al Jazeera)]
*[[New People's Army rebellion]]
**A [[Philippine Air Force]] [[KAI T-50 Golden Eagle|FA-50PH]] [[fighter aircraft|fighter jet]] is reported missing during an overnight combat operation against insurgents in [[Bukidnon]], [[Philippines]]. A [[search and rescue]] operation to locate the missing pilots is launched with both later being confirmed dead. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/two-philippine-air-force-pilots-killed-crash-2025-03-05/ (Reuters)] [https://qa.philstar.com/headlines/2025/03/04/2425796/philippine-air-force-fighter-jet-goes-missing-during-night-operations (''The Philippine Star'')]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**The [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] claim to have [[List of aircraft shootdowns|shot down]] an American [[General Atomics MQ-9 Reaper|MQ-9]] [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|UAV]], stating that it was conducting "hostile missions" over [[Al Hudaydah]]. The [[United States Air Force|U.S. Air Force]] later confirms a loss of contact with the drone. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/united-states/2025/03/05/us-says-it-lost-contact-with-mq-9-near-yemen-after-houthis-claim-to-have-shot-it-down (Al Arabiya)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Second Trump tariffs]]
**[[2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s 25% [[tariff]]s on [[Mexico|Mexican]] and [[Canada|Canadian]] imports to the [[United States]] take effect, while an existing 10% tariff on all [[China|Chinese]] imports rises to 20% amid an ongoing [[China–United States trade war|trade war]]. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-tariffs-mexico-canada-b19e004dddb579c373b247037e04424b (AP)]
***[[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] says that he will impose a reciprocal 25% tariff on American goods worth up to [[United States dollar|US$]]155 billion. [https://www.pm.gc.ca/en/news/statements/2025/03/03/statement-prime-minister-trudeau-on-unjustified-us-tariffs-against-canada (Canada.ca)]
**[[China–United States trade war]]
***The [[Ministry of Finance (China)|Chinese Ministry of Finance]] announces 10–15% tariffs on a range of US food imports, set to start March 10. [https://www.reuters.com/world/trade-wars-erupt-trump-hits-canada-mexico-china-with-steep-tariffs-2025-03-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Donald Trump speech to a joint session of Congress]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces the creation of the [[United States Office of Shipbuilding|Office of Shipbuilding]], as means to compete with [[China]] in the [[Maritime transport|maritime transport industry]]. [https://www.wsj.com/livecoverage/trump-speech-congress-joint-session/card/trump-unveils-shipmaking-office-iekrCveUYTQHRHmzT4UD (''The Wall Street Journal'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
* [[March 2025 North American blizzard]]
**A [[storm]] complex leaves over 400,000 people without power in the [[Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex]] and brings severe weather to large portions of the [[Southern United States]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/04/weather/storm-tornado-power-outages.html  (''The New York Times'')]
*A [[light aircraft]] crashes into a garden in [[Plettenberg]], [[North Rhine-Westphalia]], [[Germany]], killing the pilot on board. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-aircraft-crashes-into-garden-killing-pilot/a-71828852 (DW)]
